source_sentence: As BERT does not have cross-attention parameters, they are learned from scratch.

subject: Pre-training
source_sentence: Our pre-training dataset is comprised of image -text pairs from five fashion datasets : FACAD , Fashion -Gen , Fashion200K , Shop- ping100k , and DeepFashion .
title: FaD-VLP: Fashion Vision-and-Language Pre-training towards Unified Retrieval and Captioning

subject: Pre-training
source_sentence: For pre-training, we use the Adam optimizer with a learning rate of 10−5.
title: FaD-VLP: Fashion Vision-and-Language Pre-training towards Unified Retrieval and Captioning

subject: preprocessing
source_sentence: We use the following preprocessing/data augmentations on the images : resize to 224 × 224 pixels with a ran- dom crop, that has random scaling between 0.8 and 1.0 and aspect ratio between 0.75 and 1.3, along with a random horizontal flip.
title: FaD-VLP: Fashion Vision-and-Language Pre-training towards Unified Retrieval and Captioning

subject: preprocessing
source_sentence: We use the same preprocessing for downstream fine-tuning.
